evidence_class: new intervention outcomes on the unchanged Day 52 26-example development sandbox; not fresh confirmation
authorization: Decision 0082 records explicit user authorization and the under-USD-100 branch budget

candidate.interface: all 12 selected valid-response raw pre-o_proj query-head outputs in layers 9-12
candidate.source: the exact natural donor condition on the same teacher-forced response
candidate.target_context: all target-condition computation remains natural except the 12 selected raw-head outputs

haar.definition: per-head Haar rotation of the exact natural target-to-primary-donor K12 trajectory, added to target

primary_endpoint.name: exact natural donor K12 trajectory recovery
primary_endpoint.formula: dot(intervention - target, donor - target) / max(norm(donor - target)^2, 1e-8)
primary_endpoint.reduction: response-mask weighted within example; arithmetic mean of two examples per concept; median across 13 equal-weight concepts
primary_endpoint.controls: score Haar, exact normal K12, and exact different-donor K12 against the primary donor trajectory

promotion_gate.raw_aligned_numerator_concentration: report but do not gate, exactly as Day 52
promotion_gate.pass_consequence: run frozen Day 55 QKV-to-exact-K12 completion localization
promotion_gate.fail_consequence: run frozen Day 55 exact-K12 by layer-9-response-context factorial

implementation_gates.dtype: bfloat16 model execution; float32 intervention tensors and reductions

branch_rule.pass: selected K12 is sufficient for donor identity in fixed target context; run only per-head/layer completion localization
branch_rule.fail: selected K12 is not a self-contained donor code; run only the 2x2 exact-K12 by layer-9 response-residual-context factorial

forbidden: changing population, donors, endpoints, metrics, controls, thresholds, seeds, or weighting after outcomes
fresh data, behavior, generation, or title upgrade
